Learn Reference

Your first component

Fernkit apps are made out of components. A component is a piece of the interface that has its own logic and appearance, and it can be as small as a button or as large as an entire page.

Components are plain functions that return markup. Here is the smallest one you can write:

function MyButton() {
  return (
    <button>I'm a button</button>
  );
}

Using it

Once a component is declared you can nest it inside another one, the same way you would nest ordinary tags:

export default function App() {
  return <MyButton />;
}
